description: This is a shell script that provides a test suite for verifying the behavior of 'git merge' in various scenarios, including handling of untracked files, staged changes, renamed files, untracked directories, symlinks, and unborn branches.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with specified file content.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that expects success.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks that a specified path is missing.

methods.name: test_ln_s_add
methods.description: Creates a symbolic link and stages it.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in a file.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Sets a cleanup command to run after the test.
